AXP.rationale: American Express shows solid fundamental health with consistent revenue and EPS growth (Q1 2026 revenue +9. YoY, EPS +17.6% YoY), strong ROE of 33%, and net margins of 26.6%. The closed-loop business model provides durable competitive advantages with 160M merchant locations and 153.9M cards in force. Valuation is moderate: P/E of 22.1x sits near the middle of its 1-year range (18.4-25.3x), not expensive but not a bargain. The Platinum fee hike to $895 with stable retention supports recurring fee revenue growth. Q2 earnings on July 24 provide a near-term catalyst, with consensus EPS of $4.40 (+7.8% YoY). JPMorgan's upgrade to Overweight adds incremental positive sentiment. However, macro headwinds (rising 10Y yields at 4.57%, cooling labor market, geopolitical risks) and regulatory overhang (AML enforcement action, surcharging risks) temper enthusiasm. Balance sheet leverage (D/E 1.73x) is elevated but manageable for a financial. The score reflects a quality franchise with positive trajectory at fair-to-slightly-cheap valuation, with a modest catalyst boost from upcoming earnings.
